answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 77 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 77 epochs of grading, and every atlas settlement recomputes the knoll schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
